```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Start Table with columns matching the screenshot
cat('<table class="table" style="width:100%;">')
cat('<thead><tr>
      <th>Screenshot</th>
      <th>Repo Name</th>
      <th>Project Title</th>
      <th>Last Updated</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i]))
  
  # YOUR WORKING TECHNICAL TRICK:
  # Using HTML entities so Pandoc doesn't corrupt the image source URL
  safe_img_url <- paste0("https&#58;&#47;&#47;aakritixyz.github.io&#47;", repo, "&#47;Capture.PNG")
  
  # Standard demo URL
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo, "/")
  
  cat('<tr>')
  
  # Column 1: Screenshot (Using your safe_url trick)
  cat('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">', sep="")
  cat('<img src="', safe_img_url, '" width="300" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:4px;">', sep="")
  cat('</a></td>')
  
  # Column 2: Repo Name (.viz style)
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; font-family: monospace;">')
  cat('<a href="', demo_url, '">', repo, '.viz</a>', sep="")
  cat('</td>')
  
  # Column 3: Project Title
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;"><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>', sep="")
  
  # Column 4: Timestamp (ISO Format like Suhaani's)
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; color: #666; font-size: 0.85em;">')
  cat(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
  cat('</td>')
  
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</tbody></table>')

cat('<br><hr><h3>Source Code</h3>')
cat('<ul><li><a href="[https://github.com/aakritixyz/animint-gallery](https://github.com/aakritixyz/animint-gallery)">Repository of this gallery</a></li></ul>')
